notes.title: Sang's featured in the GOING ROGUE event!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Just a quick update post to point out that Sang: The Desert Blade has been featured in the currently running GOING ROGUE event running on Steam.

If you've discovered Sang through the event, we hope you enjoy what you see and that you look forward to seeing more of the game! Sang: The Desert Blade will also be coming to Kickstarter, where you'll be able to pre-buy copies of the game for redemption on Steam.
